searchText: Graduate Software Engineer Visa Company Description About Visa What is Visa? We are not a bank, nor are we a credit card company! Visa stands at the forefront of the global payments and technology landscape, facilitating over 259 billion secure transactions annually across more than 200 countries and territories. Our mission is to connect the world through the most innovative, convenient, reliable, and secure payments network—empowering individuals, businesses, and economies to thrive. As the world transitions from analog to digital, Visa leverages our brand, products, people, network, and scale to reshape the future of commerce. Our network seamlessly connects consumers, merchants, financial institutions, and government entities, ensuring smooth and secure payment flows worldwide. At Visa, individuality is valued. Working here provides the opportunity to make a global impact, invest in career growth, and be part of an inclusive and diverse workplace. We are a global team of disruptors, trailblazers, innovators, and risk-takers, driving economic growth even in the most remote parts of the world. We creatively advance the industry and engage in meaningful work that brings financial literacy and digital commerce to millions of unbanked and underserved consumers. You’re an individual. We’re the team for you. Together, let's transform the way the world pays. Make a meaningful impact with a purpose-driven industry leader. Join us today and discover what Life at Visa has to offer. Job Description A Software Engineer is an important software development role, working within a cohesive cross-discipline agile team on the product backlog. You will be working alongside Software Engineers with other levels of experience, as well as other scrum team members and consultants. This role requires a dedication to technical excellence, not only in writing code, but also in team-collaboration, testing, documentation. Good communication skills are essential, as well as a “can-do” attitude and willingness to work across various disciplines, if required. Software Development Developing .NET, SQL, and related front-end code. Peer reviews. Following coding style standards and guidelines. Using source control. Using Test Driven Development techniques. Writing unit and integration tests. Domain Knowledge Learning Visa Spend Clarity domain concepts. Writing documentation. Knowledge sharing with other team members. Agile Mind-set Practice agile scrum methodology. Contribute to improving team Agile processes. Active learning and an open mind. Why this is important to Visa This is an important software development role, that requires a dedication to technical excellence, not only in writing code, but also in team-collaboration, testing, and documentation. Qualifications So what are we looking for in this role? University students completing their Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or related fields at the end of 2026. Proficiency in at least one programming language or technology including, but not limited to: Java C/C++ C# .NET Python JavaScript TypeScript HTML CSS Objective-C Ideally some experience with DDD (Domain-Driven Design). Ideally some experience with TDD (Test-Driven Development). Good team collaboration skills. Strong communication skills. Good relationship building skills. Self-motivation. Attention to detail. Open mind to learning new skills and development processes Additional Information Company Description About Visa What is Visa? We are not a bank, nor are we a credit card company!
